9.item: ὕδατος τῆς ζωῆς ἐκ τῆς νηδύος τοῦ Χριστοῦ
9.source: John 7:38 wording, noted as wording match per the apparatus
9.sense_relied_on: the heavenly spring of the water of life flowing from Christ's belly — the letter's image for what sustained Sanctus
unbent and unyielding, firm toward the confession
